title: Represent SRD magic item usage and attunement rules
description:
Problem
The importer emits magic item records, but general SRD magic item usage rules are not adequately represented.

Evidence from the 2026-06-07 audit
Unrepresented source content around page 206 includes:
- Attunement rules
- Wearing and wielding items
- Paired items
- Activating magic items
- General magic item usage constraints

Required behavior
- Import general magic item rules as rule records.
- Keep general rules separate from individual magic item records.
- Preserve headings and provenance so future lookup can answer questions about attunement and activation.

IMPORTER SAFETY
Importer safety: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Do not weaken regression tests or audit expectations to match current generated output; fix parser/extractor behavior or document source-backed evidence that the expectation was wrong.
notes: Implementation complete; PR #188 open for review (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/188, branch feat/srd-magic-item-rules-eshyra-0m9-21). 10 new rule records from the new magicItemRules slice (pp206-207): chapter intro, Attunement, Wearing and Wielding Items (+2 leaves), Activating an Item (+4 leaves). Generated diff exactly +10/0/0; verify:worktree green (1391 passed/19 skipped). Sentient Magic Items deliberately stays unimported (DM construction guidance, out of audited scope). Close this bead when the PR merges.
close_reason: Merged to main as 2f2a447 (PR #188): 10 Magic Items chapter-intro usage rules (chapter intro, Attunement, Wearing and Wielding Items + leaves, Activating an Item + leaves) via new magicItemRules slice. Rule coverage 190->200.
